title: Predicator conformance corpus case
description: One completed, shipped case as it appears in conformance/corpus/tier-N.json - one JSON object per line, produced by mix corpus.generate from an authored case (schema/case.json). See conformance/README.md for the full field-by-field contract.

id.description: Human-chosen, path-like, globally unique, stable forever.

source.description: A predicator expression, or null for an evaluator-only case with no source (e.g. the legacy ["and"]/["or"] opcodes). A null-source case is absent from the compiler surface's case set, not skipped by it.

instructions.description: The compiled instruction list, tagged-value encoded. If "source" is non-null, this is what it compiles to; a compiler-surface runner compares its own compilation of "source" against this list structurally.

expected_result.description: Present iff expected_error is absent. The evaluation result, tagged-value encoded.

type.description: The error struct's short module name, e.g. "TypeMismatchError". Normative.

reason.description: A structured reason token. Normative. The error message is never carried.

tier.description: max(tier(opcode)) over the case's instructions. Running tier N means running tiers 1..N.

features.description: Feature tags, sorted and deduplicated - the finer cut across tiers.

notes.description: Free text, carried over from the authored case unchanged.
